title: AdaptiveObserverCache: persistent observer state changes how frozen memory is read
summary: AdaptiveObserverCache now has a corrected first-ask distance result. The earlier visible-filler sweep is retained as a confounded re-ask/trajectory control: its anchor already contained Qwen's first valve answer and the same question was asked again. The new harness anchors system+sources only, withholds the first question, and advances cache position using unreadable masked spacers. At distance 0, m=-1 genuinely flips the complete valve/sensor candidate winner to sensor (A-minus-B margin -0.28697) and the matched decision token to -0.75. At +256, neutral remains essentially unchanged (+11.549 versus +11.449), closing the earlier filler-landscape confound, and the matched decision token still flips more strongly toward sensor (-1.75); however the complete sensor sentence loses by +0.521 A-minus-B. The current boundary is therefore local decision control versus continuation control, not simple positional fade. The next discriminator is a tonic-versus-phasic tail test: steer through the sensor choice, then release the observer and compare the tail with tonic and neutral forced-B scoring.

nodes.claim: Tests whether a frozen transformer can carry a persistent observer/evidence state outside the prompt and a genuinely growing KV cache, so external receipts alter how unchanged historical sources are read later without rewriting model weights or old source K/V.
nodes.survived: The DistilGPT2 Gates 2–7 still establish persistent retrieval control and explicit provenance/current-address rebinding. On Qwen3-8B, causally selected frozen heads produce a real first-ask valve/sensor switch. The corrected first-ask distance harness removes the prior-answer/re-ask confound: with a 93-token source-only anchor, distance 0 at m=-1 flips the full summed sequence to B (-0.28697 A-minus-B) and the matched decision token to -0.75. After exactly 256 masked unreadable positions, source-cache integrity remains true, neutral full-sequence preference barely changes (+11.4495 to +11.5491), and the matched valve/sensor token still flips toward B even more strongly (-1.75). Thus local causal control survives the tested masked positional age.
nodes.killed: Several stronger stories remain dead. Geometry steering alone is not enough; causal head selection is required. The held-out strong generation-transfer gate failed. The earlier visible-filler distance sweep did not isolate distance because it re-asked a question after Qwen's closed first answer and changed readable conversational state. The corrected first-ask run also kills a simple 'local control implies whole continuation control' story: at +256, m=-1 selects sensor at the matched decision token but the complete B sentence still loses by +0.52131 A-minus-B. Whether that tail loss comes from positional copying difficulty or from leaving the observer active too long is not yet known.

edges.why: AinsteinInside's Gate 0.7d made the measuring apparatus itself a live variable when harmless execution geometry changed tiny causal conclusions. AdaptiveObserverCache turns that methodological lesson into a mechanism: observer state is explicit and changes how frozen transformer memory is read.

OperatorTime established the abstract form that resident history can change the effective operator available now even when parameters stay fixed. AdaptiveObserverCache instantiates that idea as a persistent reader state that changes the effective attention/query operator over unchanged memory.

ReadWrite shows that what is knowable depends on the probe/intervention rather than on passive state alone. AdaptiveObserverCache moves that bounded-observer idea inside transformer memory: the current query geometry determines which distinction in frozen K/V becomes visible.

WhatToLookAt makes remembered relations change which later measurement is worth buying. AdaptiveObserverCache Gate 7 reaches the same boundary from transformer memory: history constrains current identity, and the next planned gate explicitly prices which probe the observer should purchase.

PredictiveHKT warns that changing representation coordinates can impersonate world/operator change. AdaptiveObserverCache's identity/alias gates separate durable provenance from its current surface key/address, making coordinate translation an explicit part of memory reuse.

AuditedEpistemicCache records provenance and representation-generation receipts so old evidence is not blindly reused. AdaptiveObserverCache turns that bookkeeping principle into a read operation: old trust/history is rebound to the current representation before it may control retrieval.

AInstein's provenance-misbinding controls show that having the right ingredients with the wrong addresses can yield confident failure. AdaptiveObserverCache makes source identity/address binding a first-class operation before attention is steered.
